about: K2 push-e2e-v1 test vectors (prd-e2e-push-v1 rev 2 §3, §7.3). Generated by the K2 daemon's real seal code (crates/k2-core/src/push/vectors.rs) with fixed keys and a fixed ephemeral seed. HPKE RFC 9180 mode_psk, DHKEM(P-256, HKDF-SHA256) 0x0010, HKDF-SHA256 0x0001, AES-256-GCM 0x0002. The ephemeral key of each case is DeriveKeyPair(ikmE). Decrypt: enc = blob[2..67], ct = blob[67..], aad = blob[0..2], info per kind, psk + pskId below, sequence 0; then unpad: L = u16be(pt[0..2]), JSON = pt[2..2+L], every remaining byte 0x00.

cases.name: alert-thread-preview
cases.note: A Thread post, previews on: title = agent, body = preview.

cases.name: alert-thread-no-preview
cases.note: The same post for a phone with previews off: today's generic line by kind.

cases.name: alert-ticket
cases.note: A ticket: title K2, body "<agent> needs you on a ticket", group ticket:<id>.

cases.name: alert-project
cases.note: A project chat post, with the person's totals in data.

cases.name: alert-max-truncated
cases.note: A project post whose name makes the body ("New message in <project>") far over the 1536-byte bucket: the body is cut at a character boundary with "…" until the JSON fills the bucket. (Thread previews are already capped at 140 characters.)
